cd /code && Rscript -e 'library(readr); ds<-read_csv("/data/summary_stats_LSS2.csv", na="NaN"); cat("speed_walk_median=", median(ds$walk_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE), "
"); cat("speed_search_median=", median(ds$search_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE), "
"); cat("straight_walk_median=", median(ds$walk_straightness, na.rm=TRUE), "
"); cat("straight_search_median=", median(ds$search_straightness, na.rm=TRUE), "
")' > /results/medians.txt 2>&1 && cat /results/medians.txt
